# 04 Cost model v3 (generated by `cost_model.py`; do not edit by hand)

S1 = 5 s, 24 fps, 720p, T2V. Cost per ACCEPTED clip, **2,000 accepted clips/month**. USD/INR 93.0 (F). GST excluded everywhere (set GST in the script to test). 2.5% FX markup on foreign-billed providers (O). Engineer time $215/month on every self-host option (O). Dedicated boxes are rented all month; extra boxes are added above 85% load, so utilisation FOLLOWS volume. Acceptance is a per-option prior (O) until the blind-rating experiment measures it; the `@50%` column re-runs every option at one shared 50% to show how much that opinion matters. Rows marked **UNV** rest on an unverified generation time or price and should not carry a recommendation alone.

## Evidence notes

- **Wan2.2 TI2V-5B, RTX 4090 (RunPod secure)** (`price F / time F`): README 534.7 s on one 4090 with offload; Apache 2.0.
- **Wan2.2 A14B full, default sampler, H100 PCIe (RunPod)** (`price F / time F`): README 1041.5 s on H100/H800, 59.8 GB peak; PCIe assumed slower (O).
- **Wan2.2 A14B full, default sampler, H100 (E2E India)** (`price F / time F`): E2E price table is USD, excl. tax.
- **Wan2.2 A14B full, default sampler, H100 (Yotta India)** (`price F / time F`): Rs596 1xH100 VM; Rs428 is 8x bare metal, term unknown.
- **Wan2.2 A14B + Lightning 4-step, H100 PCIe (RunPod)** (`price F / time V`): UNVERIFIED: one JarvisLabs report 79 s on an H200 vs 643 s baseline (~8x); scaled to H100 PCIe (I). Quality drop unknown.
- **HunyuanVideo 1.5 distilled, RTX 4090 (RunPod secure)** (`price F / time I`): UNVERIFIED at 720p: Tencent '75 s' is the 480p distilled model; scaled 2.5-6x (I).
- **LTX-2.x, H100 (E2E India dedicated)** (`price F / time I`): UNVERIFIED: no primary timing exists; low = vendor '18x faster than Wan2.2-14B' on 1041 s.
- **LTX-2.x, H100 (Modal serverless)** (`price F / time I`): UNVERIFIED time; per-second billing, 60 s cold start per job (O).
- **LTX-2.x fp8+offload, RTX 5090 (RunPod secure)** (`price F / time I`): UNVERIFIED: no official VRAM/timing; bf16 weights ~66 GiB on a 32 GB card needs offload.
- **Wan2.2 A14B, IndiaAI-subsidised H100** (`price V / time F`): rate card not readable; approval required; excluded from ranking (FR3).
- **Wan 2.2 5B, fal.ai (hosted open)** (`F`): $0.15 per video <=5 s at 720p. Apache 2.0 weights, so portable.
- **Wan 2.2 A14B, fal.ai (hosted open)** (`F`): $0.08/s at 720p, $0.04/s at 480p. RISK: fal page says model removed 2027-01-04.
- **LTX-2.3 Pro, fal.ai (hosted open, 1080p)** (`F`): 1080p only ($0.06-0.08/s, page conflicts); upper bound for S1.
- **Hailuo 2.3, MiniMax (closed, 768p)** (`F/V`): $0.28 per 6 s clip at 768p (billing minimum 6 s); low = Fast tier $0.19 (V). RISK: reportedly moved to legacy list.
- **Runway Gen-4 Turbo (closed)** (`F`): $0.05/s (5 credits/s at $0.01).
- **Kling 2.6 Pro via fal.ai (closed, silent)** (`F`): $0.07/s silent; high = Kling 3.0 Pro $0.112/s.
- **Veo 3.1 Fast via fal.ai (closed, silent)** (`F`): $0.10/s silent, $0.15/s with audio.
- **Runway Gen-4.5 (closed)** (`F`): 12 credits/s.
- **Veo 3.1 Lite (closed) - UNVERIFIED** (`V`): aggregator-only; Google pages unreadable; excluded.
